defs.def: to attach sth, or to be attached, at the top so that the lower part is free or loose 悬挂；吊

ex.s: We don't always eat just to satisfy hunger.
ex.t: 我们吃东西不仅仅是为了充饥。

ex.s: After we found a crazy-looking road that hung over a bunch of rocks, we decided to photograph the scene at sunset.
ex.t: 在我们发现一条悬在一堆岩石上方、看起来奇特的路之后，我们决定在日落时拍摄这一场景。

ex.s: I felt like a storm cloud hung over me.
ex.t: 我觉得一片乌云笼罩着我。

ex.s: “What would the world be if there were no hunger?” It’s a question that Professor Crystal would ask her students.
ex.t: "如果没有饥饿，世界会是什么样？"这是Crystal教授会问她学生的问题。

ex.s: It helps to prove why hunger exists.
ex.t: 它有助于证明为什么存在饥饿。

ex.s: SILENCE in big black letters was on signs hung everywhere If she thought you were dressed improperly, she sent you straight back home to change your clothes.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的"安静"标志到处都是如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: He   25   the police department to allow him to   26   a couple of “chat benches” in two of their local parks, Then he hung a colorful sign on each of the benches that   27   ：“HAPPY TO CHAT”.
ex.t: 他___25___警察局允许他在当地两个公园里___26___几条“聊天长椅”，然后在每条长椅上挂了一块彩色牌子，上面___27___：“乐意聊天”。

ex.s: And speaking of hanging out, I’m hoping that self-driving cars are available soon.
ex.t: 说到出去玩，我希望自动驾驶汽车能尽快上市。

defs.def: when sth hangs in a particular way, it falls in that way 垂下；垂落

ex.s: But when the leaves hang trembling, The wind is passing through.
ex.t: 但当树叶颤抖时，是风正在穿过。

defs.def: to bend or let sth bend downwards （使）低垂，下垂
to kill sb, usually as a punishment, by tying a rope around their neck and allowing them to drop; to be killed in this way （被）绞死，施以绞刑

ex.s: Hanging pictures were thrown down, but more often, by a curious freak of the earthquake’s humor, they were whirled completely around with their faces to the wall!
ex.t: 挂着的画被震落下来，但更常见的是，由于地震的一种奇特的恶作剧，它们被完全旋转过来，面朝墙壁！

ex.s: Meg found time hanging heavily and started cutting and spoiling her clothes, trying to make them more fashionable.
ex.t: 梅格觉得时间过得很慢，开始裁剪和糟蹋她的衣服，试图让它们更时尚。

defs.def: to attach sth, especially a picture, to a hook on a wall; to be attached in this way （使）挂在墙上

ex.s: Several violins hung from the dark walls, quietly waiting to be chosen.
ex.t: 几把小提琴挂在暗色的墙上，静静地等待着被选中。

ex.s: He looked up and saw Eric hanging from the balcony.
ex.t: 他抬头一看，看到Eric挂在阳台上。

ex.s: Plastic bags hung in trees.
ex.t: 塑料袋挂在树上。

ex.s: “But as I grew older,” Adeline says, "and missed my brother more and more, I realized that was the only thing we had left." Corrado Piccoli’s Purple Heart medal now hangs at the Italian American Civic Association in Watertown.
ex.t: "但随着年龄的增长，"阿德琳说，"而且我越来越想念我的哥哥，我才意识到这是我们唯一留下的东西。"科拉多·皮科利的紫心勋章现在挂在沃特敦意大利美国公民协会。

ex.s: They spend quite a lot of time eating, sleeping, and hanging onto tree trunks, so interaction with humans can cause them a lot of stress.
ex.t: 它们花大量时间吃东西、睡觉和挂在树干上，所以与人类互动会给它们造成很大的压力。

defs.def: to decorate a place by placing paintings, etc. on a wall 挂图画等装饰（某处）
to stick wallpaper to a wall （在墙上）贴壁纸
to attach a door or gate to a post so that it moves freely 把（门）装在门柱上；装（门）
to stay in the air 悬浮（在空中）
to wait or stay near a place, not doing very much （在某处附近）等待，逗留，闲荡
to be very slow doing sth 慢悠悠
停一下；等一等
to hold sth tightly 抓紧
等一下；停一下
to wait for sth to happen 等待某事发生；等候
别挂电话，等一下

ex.s: But when he finally reached her, the woman flooded him with questions: "Who are you？What antique shop？" However, when she hung up, she regretted the way she had handled the call.
ex.t: 但当他终于联系上她时，这位女士连珠炮似地问了他很多问题："你是谁？哪家古董店？"然而，当她挂断电话后，她后悔自己处理这次通话的方式。

defs.def: to continue doing sth in difficult circumstances （在逆境中）坚持，不放弃

ex.s: He hung on for a few minutes   61   screamed for his father, but his father didn't hear him.
ex.t: 他抓住栏杆坚持了几分钟，   61  尖叫着喊他爸爸，但他爸爸没听到。

defs.def: to hold sth tightly 抓紧某物
to keep sth, not sell it or give it away 保留；不卖掉；不放弃
to fit together well; to be the same as or consistent with each other 相符；一致；连贯

ex.s: There’s also an area on the rooftop for hanging out with other travelers during the summer.
ex.t: 屋顶还有一片区域，夏天可以和其他旅行者闲逛。

defs.def: to support or help one another 人

ex.s: For those who hunger for some peace and quiet, sound can now create silence.
ex.t: 对于那些渴望安宁与清静的人来说，声音现在可以创造寂静。

ex.s: I gave the homeowner a recording of the hunger screams of owl chicks.
ex.t: "爵士乐似乎并不真正是美国人的胃口，"莫兰告诉美国国家公共广播电台记者尼尔·科南。
